topic: Laws of Indices • RRB Group D Level-1 (03 Aug 2026 Shift 2)

question.en: Given that 17 0.3 = x, 17 0.5 = y and x z = y 5 , then the value of z is close to:
question.hi: दिया है कि 17 0.3 = x, 17 0.5 = y और x z = y 5 है , तो z का मान किसके निकटतम है ?

solution.approach: Verified Answer: **8.33** ($z = 8.3333 \approx 8.33$).
solution.keyConcept: Same Base Power Law: B^{p·z} = B^{q·k} ⇒ z = (q × k) / p

optionTrick.en: Ignore dummy base 17! Directly equate exponents: $0.3z = 0.5 \times 5 = 2.50 \Rightarrow z = 2.50 / 0.3 \approx 8.33$.
optionTrick.hi: डमी आधार 17 को छोड़ें! सीधे घात बराबर करें: $0.3z = 0.5 \times 5 \Rightarrow z \approx 8.33$।

title.hi: विधि 1: आधार समान कर घातों की तुलना

steps.en:
Substitute $x = 17^{0.3}$ and $y = 17^{0.5}$ into $x^z = y^{5}$:
$17^{0.3z} = 17^{0.5 \times 5} = 17^{2.50}$.
Since bases are equal, $0.3z = 2.50 \Rightarrow z = \frac{2.50}{0.3} = 8.3333 \approx \mathbf{8.33}$.

title.en: Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`)

solution.en:
Method 1: Base Substitution & Exponent Equating: Substitute $x = 17^{0.3}$ and $y = 17^{0.5}$ into $x^z = y^{5}$:
$17^{0.3z} = 17^{0.5 \times 5} = 17^{2.50}$.
Since bases are equal, $0.3z = 2.50 \Rightarrow z = \frac{2.50}{0.3} = 8.3333 \approx \mathbf{8.33}$.

Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`): Ratio of exponents $0.5 : 0.3 = 5 : 3$ ⇒ $z = \frac{5 \times 5}{3} = 25/3 \approx \mathbf{8.33}$.
solution.hi:
विधि 1: आधार समान कर घातों की तुलना: $x = 17^{0.3}$ व $y = 17^{0.5}$ को $x^z = y^{5}$ में रखें:
$17^{0.3z} = 17^{2.50} \Rightarrow 0.3z = 2.50 \Rightarrow z \approx \mathbf{8.33}$।

विधि 2: सीधा अनुपात सूत्र (`4 सेकंड`): सीधा $z = \frac{0.5 \times 5}{0.3} \approx \mathbf{8.33}$।

topic: Percentage Increase/Decrease • RRB Group D Level-1 (03 Aug 2026 Shift 2)

question.en: The income of Raman is ₹70,000. He saves 26% of his income. If his income increases by 32% and expenditure increases by 45%, then his savings will:
question.hi: रमन की आय ₹70,000 है। वह अपनी आय का 26% बचाता है। यदि उसकी आय में 32% की वृद्धि हो जाती है और व्‍यय में 45% की वृद्धि हो जाती है , तो उसकी बचत पर क्‍या प्रभाव पड़ेगा ?

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option D (**decrease by ₹910**).
solution.keyConcept: Direct Change Law: ΔSavings = ΔIncome − ΔExpenditure

optionTrick.en: Notice net $\%$ change in income = $+32\%$, while expenditure change on whole income = $-\frac{74}{100} \times 45\%$. That gives direct Net Factor $= -1.3\%$ of ₹70,000 $= \mathbf{Rs.910}$!
optionTrick.hi: आय वृद्धि $= +32\%$ तथा आय के सापेक्ष व्यय वृद्धि $= 74\% \times 45\% = 33.3\%$ — दोनों का अंतर ही ₹70,000 पर सीधी कमी ($\mathbf{Rs.910}$) है!

trapAlert.en: Never waste 60 seconds calculating New Income and New Expenditure first! Only compute ΔI and ΔE and take ΔS = ΔI − ΔE (positive = increase, negative = decrease).
trapAlert.hi: पुरानी-नई आय अलग से निकालकर 60 सेकंड बर्बाद न करें; सीधे $\Delta\text{बचत} = \Delta\text{आय} - \Delta\text{व्यय}$ सूत्र से चिह्न (+ वृद्धि / − कमी) तय करें।

title.en: Method 2: Smart ΔS = ΔI − ΔE (12 sec)
title.hi: विधि 2: स्मार्ट Δबचत = Δआय − Δव्यय ट्रिक

solution.en:
Method 1: Basic Income-Expenditure Table: 1) Old Savings $= 26\%$ of ₹70,000 = **₹18,200**; Old Expenditure $= 74\%$ of ₹70,000 = **₹51,800**.
2) New Income ($+32\%$) = **₹92,400**; New Expenditure ($+45\%$) = **₹75,110**.
3) New Savings $= Rs.92,400 - Rs.75,110 = Rs.17,290$.
4) Change $= Rs.17,290 - Rs.18,200 \Rightarrow$ **Decrease of ₹910**.

Method 2: Smart ΔS = ΔI − ΔE (12 sec): 1) $\Delta I = +32\%$ of ₹70,000 = **+₹22,400**.
2) $E = 74\% \times Rs.70,000 = Rs.51,800$, so $\Delta E = +45\% \times Rs.51,800 = +Rs.23,310$.
3) $\Delta S = Rs.22,400 - Rs.23,310 = -Rs.910 \Rightarrow$ **Decrease by ₹910**.
